data.title: Add sorting options to list command
data.body:
## Goal

Add sorting options to `docket list`, with priority as the default or primary sort.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket list --sort priority` sorts by priority (High → Medium → Low)
- [ ] `docket list --sort created` sorts by creation date (current default)
- [ ] `docket list --sort status` sorts by status
- [ ] `docket list` defaults to priority sort (or make it configurable)
- [ ] Secondary sort: within same priority, sort by created date
- [ ] `--reverse` flag to invert sort order

## Context

Currently `docket list` sorts by creation date (newest first). Sorting by priority makes more sense for "what should I work on?" - you want High priority bugs at the top.

Ideal default sort:
1. Priority (High → Medium → Low)
2. Within same priority: oldest first (FIFO)

This surfaces the most important, longest-waiting bugs at the top.

Example:
```
ID    STATUS    PRIORITY  TITLE
abc1  approved  high      Security vulnerability
def2  approved  high      Payment bug
ghi3  approved  medium    Add dark mode
jkl4  draft     medium    Refactor utils
mno5  approved  low       Update docs
```

## Log

## Log

- 2026-01-14: Implemented sorting options for list command:
  - Added `SortBy` enum with Priority, Created, Status variants
  - Added `Ord` implementations for Priority (High→Medium→Low) and Status (InProgress→Approved→Draft→Done→NotPlanned)
  - Added `--sort` flag with default "priority" and `--reverse` flag
  - Secondary sort within same primary field is by created date (oldest first / FIFO)
  - Added 14 unit tests for sorting types and 6 integration tests for CLI sorting
  - All 67 tests pass
